unit: US dollars for each million tokens, as decimal strings
about: Row 40: the token prices OpenAI, Anthropic and Google publish for their APIs, for a driver to report as a model's provider price when the provider's own listing carries none. The owner's own rate, set in the console, always wins. A model is listed only when it has one flat price for input and one for output: a model whose price depends on the prompt's length is left out, so its cost is unknown until the owner sets a rate, never understated. Copied into the inference driver by scripts/vendor-platform.py; refresh it, and its asOf date, before each release.
